important_factors: Storage capacity limit of 200.00 m³ (max 656 units)
Policy limit of maximum 12 days cover (max 204 units closing inventory)
Projected baseline stockout on 2026-09-27 with 300 units of unmet demand
Supplier SUP-A lead time of 7 days (arrival on 2026-09-24) at $13.00 per unit
assumptions: Demand will materialize according to the forecast of 17 units/day over the 28-day planning horizon.
args.rationale:
The recommendation to buy 800 units must be modified to 500 units. Ordering 800 units is infeasible because peak occupancy would reach 204.00 m³, breaching the node storage capacity limit of 200.00 m³, and closing inventory would be 500 units (29.4 days of cover), violating the 12-day max cover policy (204 units limit).

Usable stock is currently 176 units. Based on a forecast of 17 units/day over 28 days (476 units total), a stockout occurs on 2026-09-27, resulting in 300 units of unmet demand. Ordering 500 units from SUP-A at $13.00/unit ($6,500.00 total) arriving on 2026-09-24 completely eliminates the 300 units of unmet demand, respects storage capacity (peak occupancy of 198.00 m³ <= 200.00 m³), and satisfies policy limits (closing inventory of 200 units = 11.8 days of cover <= 12 days).
